Motion.name: Motion Art
Motion.text: Motion art is where my visuals come alive through movement. These are video-based works — loops, short films, or cinematic sequences — often built from AI-generated imagery, sound, and editing. They are designed to be immersive, playing on large screens, in galleries, or as digital editions. Each piece is crafted to feel alive, shifting with rhythm and atmosphere, inviting the viewer into a world of transformation.
Motion.short: Motion art is where my visuals come alive through movement. These are video-based works — loops, short films, or cinematic sequences — often built from AI-generated imagery, sound, and editing.

New-Media.name: New-Media
New-Media.text: New media works are created with digital and AI-driven processes. These include AI-generated still images, refined through digital manipulation and enhancement, often printed as fine art editions. They explore identity, impermanence, and transformation through generative systems — artworks that exist between human intention and machine interpretation.
New-Media.short: New media works are created with digital and AI-driven processes. These include AI-generated still images, refined through digital manipulation and enhancement, often printed as fine art editions.

Mixed-Media.name: Mixed-Media
Mixed-Media.text: Mixed media art combines physical materials on surfaces like MDF panels or canvas. I use elements such as epoxy resin, broken glass, chipboard, and cloth to create layered, tactile works that are both sculptural and pictorial. Each material carries symbolic weight, and together they form multidimensional compositions that explore emotion, fragility, and resilience.
Mixed-Media.short: Mixed media art combines physical materials on surfaces like MDF panels or canvas. I use elements such as epoxy resin, broken glass, chipboard, and cloth to create layered, tactile works that are both sculptural and pictorial.
